nom: Philosophy Ultimate Miracle Worker Lift and Firm Face and Neck Serum

avis.texte: I used it and all of a sudden my face was dry with like chapped areas- it could not be the product I stopped - then tried again being very careful not to mix products! OMG my face literally hurts it is so dry and I have 3 areas that look chapped!
I have t noticed any major changes for the price I paid but I'll keep using to see if that changes over time.
I like the consistency of this product and it doesn't feel too heavy on. I don't mind the scent it isn't too strong and I love the packaging super sleek and easy to use.

I was incentivized by Influenster and Philosophy with this complementary item in exchange for my honest review. This serum was quite shocking in how well it worked and the quality of product and packaging alike. Let me explain… The bottle has so much weight to it which makes a big difference because I didn't think it was going to fall out of my grasp. The pump feature is well made and dispensed the product evenly without any "spit ups". The serum is medium-weight with visible hydration bubbles that burst onto your skin when you rub them in. The serum was a little tacky on my fingers after I applied it to my face… but nothing handwashing didn't take care of. I felt like the hydration lasted all day and I started to notice my face had less dry patches overtime because I have serious combination & T-Zone problems. There are 1 million serums out there, but this one is a stand alone. You will notice your skin feeling more refreshed and alive then you knew you were missing. So glad I found this product.

The scent is very light and pleasant on this product. It seems to absorb nicely and goes on very easily. It's like a serum feel to it. It seems to be good at what it's supposed to do with the retinol and firming the face!

Philosophy UMW life and smooth face and neck is a wonderful experience lotion that absorbs quickly also it is a golden/tan color but does not color the skin. It did not rub off on clothing. I used it for 2 weeks and did not notice a difference.

After using this for quite a while, I feel like it does actually make a difference. It feels nice going on and it's a good part of a nighttime routine. I've actually passed this on to my mother to see if it can work more dramatically on more mature skin.
I brought this serum on a trip and my skin has never looked better. My skin looked so fresh and glowing. I love that it was great for face and neck- I looked lifted and firm.

I used this product for a while and unfortunately didn't realize a difference. The formula sparkled so I didn't want to use it on my face so I mainly used it on my neck. The packaging was fine but I thought that retinol wasn't supposed to be exposed to air to still work before application

Wonderful! A new part of my routine. Smooth texture. No smell. Absorbs fully into skin so you can layer other products on top in a timely manner. I see a difference. I usually use Lancôme Genefique and this is comparable. Lightweight. Generous size. Only need a pump and a half if that for full face. Doesn't dry face even though there's retinol in it.
This a good serum and I did notice the benefits with consistent use! Didn't make my skin dry or irritated. I did start using it slowly as directed and then increased to regular use.

This serum combines a high percentage of retinol with peptides and niacinimide and helped my 38 year old skin look more glowy and youthful. I sandwich my retinol and start slow building up over time to allow my skin to get used to it which helps a lot. No funky smell, no breakouts!
This stuff is great for firming that 40 year old lose skin on your neck (aka turkey neck lol if you know you know). The smell isn't bad. It goes on smooth.

I didn't really love or hate this product. I just felt like it was okay. I didn't notice a difference in my face or neck at all. I liked that the texture was smooth and the serum was a very pretty coppery color. I thought it absorbed okay. Maybe it was just my skin, but I felt like I had to rub a lot and then it felt heavy on my skin especially after washing my face. The product smelled nice too.

This serum worked well on my skin and had good coverage and is lasting. I tend to have dry skin so I enjoyed the silky feeling of it as I applied it to my skin. I used it on my neck and that is where I really noticed a difference in less wrinkles and smoother skin. The serum doesn't have a strong smell - I would say very faint which I like. This product is dermatologist-developed. I have sensitive skin and I had no issues using it daily. I smooth it on and apply moisturizer sunscreen. While I believe it is on the expensive side - I would recommend this product.

avis.titre: first philosophy, product out of many
avis.texte: I was weary of this product because it was new and it has retinol in it. I've been using it since I received it and my skin feels great. I have sensitive combination skin and it has not irritated me at all.

avis.titre: I love this product and highly recommended
avis.texte: Feels very nice on my skin. Makes my face feel a little tighter. It didn't give me any breakouts but my skin isn't too sensitive. The scent isn't overwhelming. It's a nice product that I'm going to continue on using.

I have never been much of a philosophy fan, their skin care products just never really worked for me until this one. I am a 40yoF and I love my retinol and serums, and this one is very strong and I noticed how beautiful and tight my pores and skin look after using this and how much it is made my neck look wonderful! I use this about once every three days and I will continue to use this probably forever. I'm a big fan!

I have been using and enjoying this face and neck serum from Philosophy. It glides on, sinks into the skin pretty quickly, & wears well under makeup. The serum has no scent & dries down nicely. I have noticed the increased cell turn over, as I have needed to exfoliate more often, so I do believe it works.

This was not it for me. The rust brown color was not a favorite for me. The formula feels slightly sticky after drying. And that's on a freshly washed face. The smell was unpleasant for me, though maybe my nose is weird. My forehead still feels a little dry, but that might be because I didn't use a lot of product. I will not be buying this product.

I have been using the Philosophy UMW lift & smooth face and neck serum for several weeks. It is a thicker serum consistency, feels moisturizing on application and absorbs quickly. It is certainly packed with great ingredients including retinol, retinal and peptides. I am 47 years old with fine lines, not deep wrinkles. I can say that I don't have new lines or wrinkles since using this serum. I haven't noticed any miracles or younger looking skin. I do think it's an amazing option for people who can't tolerate a traditional retinol. This serum did not cause any irritation or increased dryness to my skin and I was able to apply it consistently daily without any issues.

This is superb! It's too soon to see significant improvement in my lines but it definitely helps my skin look more snatched and firm. It goes on smooth, doesn't irritate my skin, and feels comfortable all day. No issues!l except the price tag. I'm going to keep using this and hope to see bigger changes over time!

Before I started this product I was noticing some fine lines in my smile lines and after using for a few weeks they are less noticeable and my skin seems to be bouncier. This product is a thin consistency you would expect from a serum. I didn't notice a scent. It dries quickly but leaves behind a slightly sticky feel.
This lift and smooth serum does not irritate my skin. It's gentle and leaves my skin feeling smooth. It absorbs well and I am looking forward to seeing a difference in my fine lines.

I have been using this retinol consistently so I can get the best results. It has made my skin look tighter and more refreshed. I focus on my neck because I have dark wrinkle lines and it's has helped. Make sure to moisturizer heavy because it caused some dryness on me. I will keep using this product

avis.titre: Great results that show reduced fines lines/wrinkl
avis.texte: I used this for a few weeks and was impressed with the texture and how quickly iabsorbed into my skin with no sticky feeling. i used it 2 times a day with no irritation whatsoever. I can see how well it diminished my fine lines/wrinkles enough that others noticed it and asked what i was using. love the modern sleek packaging as well!

A beautiful retinol serum for my skin that helped me with early signs of wrinkles. I started using every other day and I didn't not have any redness or irritation. I am now using daily and my skin looks refreshed and reenergized. It is easy to dispense and I'm not sticking my fingers in a tub. It is a pump. The serum is smooth and works well under makeup. No stickiness noted.

I love the texture of this serum. It's a great beginner friendly retinol product and is not harsh on the skin. Moisturizing but thin enough to layer with other skincare steps. No weird smells or harshness. Beautiful bottle

avis.titre: Great addition to nighttime skincare routine
avis.texte: Great sleek and high-end packaging. The product is a little bit strong so you have to start slow and build up the amount and the frequency of use. It has a smooth consistency and goes on beautifully, it has a slight iridescence to it, so it actually makes your skin look glowy. It has somewhat of a strong unpleasant smell at first, but it goes away after a couple of minutes. Overall, I really enjoy adding this to my nighttime skin care a few times a week.
I really enjoyed using this product! Obviously, I haven't used it long enough to see any anti-aging effects but my skin feels great when I use it.
Really nice and light. Doesn't irritate my skin which I love. I can't tell the results that much but I do think it's working. I think over more time I will be able to tell

avis.titre: Beautiful serum to turn back the time
avis.texte: This is a really creamy and fast absorbing serum. It had no scent and was easy to apply. My skin drank it up quickly and had no stickiness to it. My skin loved it and I've noticed a difference in fine lines. I love the bottle- sleek, and well done- it's pretty enough to leave out on your counter which I love.

Bottle is a nice sturdy metal I believe it is. I've dropped it & nothing happened to it. Texture is almost like a gel but it's nice in the way that when you pump it the serum doesn't run all on your hands. I have sensitive skin & it didn't make me itchy/red/breakout. Does feel nice on your skin & not oily.

avis.titre: Has shimmer and causes sensitivity to heat
avis.texte: It has a nice consistency for easy application. It doesn't feel too slimy or leave a sticky residue after using it. I had no problems building up to using it nightly but I did notice my skin became more sensitive to heat. I waxed my eyebrows and got burnt from the wax when the only change I had made was using this product. The wax wasn't even hot. This also has a glitter/shimmer in it that I noticed after applying which is why I used it at night. I didn't notice any lifting but my face did feel smoother after using it for a month.it didn't cause my skin to breakout or any rash or irritation.

This gel like cream goes on smoothly and feels cooling on my skin. I really like how it feels and I can't wait to see the results the more I use it. It absorbs pretty quick and drys down just as fast.
Not sure ira benefits. No reduction in fine lines around the eyes or mouth. At least it doesn't have a sticky residue.

Basic packaging. Not greasy or sticky. Has not cause any breakouts. Would like it to have less ingredients. Follow the directions because it can cause skin to be sensitive to sun exposure. We need to use more to see if it actually lifts and smooths older skin.

I received this product a few months ago and have been using it daily. The serum says to use it up to 2x per day but it dried my skin out (as expected from retinol), so I decided once at night was fine enough. I had to stop using retinol products a year and a half ago because I was trying to conceive and then got pregnant. So my skin needed some TLC desperately. I actually see a huge difference over the past 2 months and would 100% buy this again. You can see in the pictures it has a gold shimmer so bare that in mind if you use it in the morning and then apply makeup or other skin care.

Great product. It applies so smoothly without leaving a sticky residue. My skin feels moisturized and refreshed in the morning. It claims to be forming and lifting, but I have not noticed a major difference. I apply this to my face and neck at night with no irritation or reaction.

avis.titre: High end retinoid that didn't cause irritation
avis.texte: I was already using a nightly retinoid so I decided to jump right in with this one and apply each night. I didn't experience sensitivity, irritation or redness. However I did have some purging and congestion of my skin where it didn't feel smooth and I had some breakouts from the purging. However after that cleared after a few weeks my skin is now so smooth and I can feel the difference each night when I apply it. The packaging feels high end and the bottle is heavy. The pump top works very well and is smooth to use. I would recommend this and would put it on my approve to repurchase list.
Wow I love this. I truly didn't expect much and it's been so long since trying a philosophy product but this product improved my skin texture. Follow the instructions and you should be fine!

avis.titre: All in one neck and face cream with Retinol
avis.texte: A good product that works on both face and neck to help control fine lines and lack of firmness. The philosophy brand is known for its commitment to quality ingredients and I feel that comes through. The formula is quick absorbing, and does not leave a sticky feeling. I did not experience any irritation during my continued usage over a month. The control of fine lines will need a longer period of use to confirm. It does feel tight around the neck, but you will have to diligently use it. This product does not spread a lot so you will need a sizable amount of- start with small then take as much as you need. Finally, the packaging is gorgeous - it's a heavy feeing bottle with a beautiful disty rose color.

Really enjoyed using this product and saw progress even if I didn't use it as directed. I tend to be in the sun quite a bit so I use this product every other day so my face won't burn or get affected by the sun as it does have that warning. It's definitely worth a shot!

avis.titre: Effective, smooth Skin and Neck serum from Philoso
avis.texte: I loved trying the Philosophy Smooth Face and Neck Serum compliments of Influenster in exchange for my honest option! My neck, especially, has been suffering from dry, crepey skin with increasing lines, as I age. The serum goes on smoothly and doesn't cause any redness or irritation. My skin looks better and feels smoother. I see a marked difference in the texture of my skin. My neck looks tighter and I will continue using this until the bottle is empty. The packaging is streamlined and has a nice fluid pump that distributes to serum evenly. There isn't really a smell to it and it feels silky going on. It absorbs quickly and doesn't leave any greasy residue. I cannot wait to see further results.
I dont want to post a fake review, i haven't had the chance to try this as I was trying out the other skincare I received from influencer. My skin wont like all the switch ups

This is a beautiful package, great dispenser and pretty consistency / texture for this serum. That being said, I did not see much of a difference after using this on my neck and face. It did not irritate me or dry me out, which I expected with my sensitive skin, but I wouldn't purchase this as I did not see any positive change.

Beautiful packaging on the box and serum container that has a nice pump. Love that there isn't a noticeable fragrance. I think with long term use this product will show results. One thing I noticed it felt a little tacky but this just might be on my skin type. Looking forward to using it longer.

This face serum is high quality, doesn't smell bad, and is comfortable on the skin. It seems to sink in nicely and not leave my skin tacky. I didn't notice any irritation specifically but unfortunately it seems to break me out. I got a giant chin pimple that took forever to go away. My skin maybe getting more sensitive to new products in my routine as I'm getting older. For this reason it won't make it into my daily routine. If you love Philosophy skin care and don't have reactive skin this I'd probably a great product for you.

avis.titre: No irritation on sensitive skin great for fine lin
avis.texte: I've been using this product for a month. It seems to tighten fine lines with no irritation. I have sensitive skin and this has not upset my skin at all. I do not wear it if I know I will be in the sun all day because it does have retinol. Big bottle with a nice pump so you don't have to do in a jar. No strong smell and it's light and absorbing

Been using for 4 weeks now and am really liking it ! I did start out using every day, my skin is used to Tretinion, so I had no problems. I get a lot of compliments on my skin and at age 67 I'll take all I can get !

avis.titre: Not sure if product is working on me
avis.texte: I was really excited to try this product however I'm not sure if I see any changes to my face or neck. I really like the sleek packaging and the smell isnt strong like some products I've tried in the past however I did notice that my face itched a bit after applying it but it didnt turn red or like a rash so maybe the itching is normal ?? I didnt notice any hydration, tightness or anything along those lines but I'll continue to use this product and see if any changes do occur. (1st pic is before I started using product, 2nd pic was today applying product)

I used this every night for 30 days and i have seen such a big improvement. First my acne has cleared up and the fine line around my lips and eyes have softened. My complexion is clearer and it never dried my dry skin out. A lot of retinols make my skin flakey and dry and this didn't do that.. It's a lightweight gel texture that skins in the skin so beautifully and doesn't pill up after putting on the rest of my skincare. I am in love with this product and will be repurchasing this forever!!
Im obsessed with this retinol serum! It has certainly helped to firm up my skin and make it glowy and pretty! It absorbs super quickly which I love.

I'm pretty neutral on this product. I haven't exactly seen a benefit, but it also hasn't caused any issues or irritation. I'm very sensitive to retinols and they usually make my face extremely dry and irritated. This did not. It also felt nice when applied. I just don't think I'd repurchase since I didn't see any changes. Maybe it takes more time.

Absorbs easily, has a nice texture, and no strong fragrance. Has a subtle iridescence which is appealing. It's not greasy at all. Doesn't make my face feel tight. I didn't see a lot of difference in my fine lines or wrinkles, but perhaps I need to use it for a longer time.

Amazing results with this face serum. I've noticed such hydration and my acne improved with in just few weeks of using this face neck serum. I did not have any irritation, it goes on smooth and it stays on light. Definitely would recommend

I absolutely loved this Philosophy UMW lift & smooth face & neck serum. It was been one of the very few product have have really worked. My faces feels soft and hydrated after I use it not like others that makes my face feel very dry. Dies not leave my face red. I feel that it took about 3 weeks to start noticing results for a much smoother look on my face and neck.
Unfortunately I was not able to test this product as it deserves. I would say the texture feels smooth and the lives a nice skin. For me the value of the product is fair

I really enjoyed using this product so far. I haven't seen visible results yet, but it has only been a few weeks that I have been using it consistently. I like.the textura, super smooth and doesn't go on greasy.

I've been loving the serum feels great on my skin. Doesn't have that sticky feeling that some serums have no bad smell and my skin has been looking great. I can't say enough about philosophy they have such good products. I've never encountered any bad products from them.

I've been using the Philosophy Ultimate Miracle Worker face and neck serum for a few weeks now, and overall I'm really impressed. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without feeling greasy, which I love. My skin definitely looks smoother and a bit more firm, especially around my jawline and neck. I also noticed a subtle glow after consistent use. That said, it's pretty strong. If your skin is sensitive or you're new to retinol, you'll want to ease into it because it can be a little drying at first. I had to adjust how often I use it to make sure I was layering with a good moisturizer. For the price, I do think it delivers noticeable results, just not quite "miracle" level. Still, a solid product that I'll likely keep in my routine.

Non irritating formula that gives a nice plump to the skin after washing and before moisturizing. Love the ingredient list and a dime side gets the job done. Hoping to see results overtime but so far I am pleased

Wow they used like a metal bottle for this and it makes it feel so luxurious. I think it keeps the serum fresh and it gets less damage from outside heat. This serum won't work miracles overnight. It takes time to see results, so be patient! I started seeing my skin looking firmer and tighter after a month of using it. I highly recommend it! You don't need to use a lot and it's meant to be applied every other day. This bottle will last a while for me. It does have retinal and retinol so if your skin is sensitive, take baby steps to have your skin be used to it. I didn't have any irritation when I used it.

I have been using this product for a few weeks and I haven't noticed a difference. It might take a while to show any difference in my skin but I don't find it irritating which is a plus for me. It seems to be mild compared to other products of the same type. It doesn't have any strong scent either. I would recommend giving it a try.

This was easy to dispense and a lot didn't come out with one pump. I used 2 pumps on my face and that was enough for me. It went on smoothly and absorbed quickly. I used this product for a month and didn't notice any changes in my face.
I really enjoyed this serum! It absorbs very quickly (I'm lazy lol) and it doesn't upset my sensitive skin! There is definitely a bit of a purging period but I think it's worth it.

I received this product in exchange for my review. I think it had incorporated well into my current routine and has improved some fine lines in conjunction with some other products! Definitely worth checking out. Wasn't super harsh on my skin either!

Super excited to get this face product in exchange for my honest review! The cap seems to stay on pretty tight and the pump is really nice too! The product looks stunning, with some iridescence to it. It does have a bit of a smell that I didn't care too much for, but that's just personal preference. I unfortunately could only try this product for a brief amount of time as it does contain retinol and shortly after starting to use the product, I found out I was pregnant, so I can't speak to the looooong term effects. Definitely going to continue using this product when it is safe for me to do so again though!

I've been using the Philosophy Ultimate Miracle Worker Lift & Firm Face & Neck Serum and have seen great results. My mature skin looks & feels firmer. The pump makes it easy to dispense and serum absorbs quickly with no stickiness. I now use daily and have had no irritation. This will definitely continue to be a regular part of my daily skincare routine.

avis.titre: A little goes a long way
avis.texte: I'm in love with the packaging and pumping mechanism. You get just the right amount. I need more use time, but as of now, my skin appears to love it. My face appears smoother. I've had no adverse reaction, and I'm able to apply twice per day.

This face an neck serum is very luxe. Orange serum that absorbs quickly with not sticky residue. The lightest scent that almost disappears in seconds. You have to be careful with sun exposure with this since it has retinol. I've had no reaction but always wear your sunscreen. My skin feels firm and supple. Great for fine lines. Need more time to see long term results

My neck and face has been a little wrinkly lately after loosing 45 pounds. I've used other creams to help and while they make an immediate difference, it wouldn't last. By mid day my neck was back to being wrinkly. I tried this cream and woah! What a difference! It goes on so smooth, and lasts all day! And a little goes a long way! It's not greasy or thick. It really is an amazing product and I will continue to purchase.
Used serum on my face and neck and it was great! Lots of product, looked good for fine lines around my smile lines, not super oily and good value. I enjoyed using it and it felt luxurious.

Enjoyed using this product. It was not too drying on my skin. Caused little discomfort and no irritation. After using for 4 weeks, there are slight changes in my wrinkles. The packaging was attractive and easy to open. The serum is soft and smooth with no scent. Tapping into skin works best.

This is a great serum from a very reputable brand. It isn't greasy and is lightweight. It is easily layered under makeup or moisturizer. It has a slight scent but it is not unpleasant. My skin is already looking a bit smoother!

This serum is on the thicker side, which I appreciate! It feels nice and smooth when applying and it goes great under my moisturizer. It doesn't leave a greasy feel after application and works great for my dry skin. It feels firm, without the tightness from dryness.
Packaging was sleek and cute. Works great on mature skin. Helps after s couple uses and its great. Your skin looks nice snd shine & firm. Helps with acne.
The bottle is a bit heavy itself but it's the only issue of the product. The smell is amazing, the cream is smooth and leaves you fresh and not greasy

This is great for my sensitive skin! I typically have a hard time with any product like this since my face is SO sensitive. This was gentle, went in so smoothly, and did not cause ANY irritation. Even after using it every single night for a month! I can see my skin texture is better and smoother after using for a month as well! The packaging is very sturdy and luxurious as well. I love this so much for my sensitive skin!

I didn't realize a significant difference after using this for a couple weeks. He didn't notice any change to my skin no tightening no lift kind of disappointing I had high expectations No visible firmness.

avis.titre: A Little goes a long way
avis.texte: My skin has loving it, the bright Orange color is so unique and the texture feels incredibly silky and luxurious. What surprised me most was the speed i aplied it at night and by the next morning, My skin felt completely different, so soft anf deeply hydrated 💞

This serum is perfect for anyone new to retinol. The added peptides make it hydrating and gentle on your skin. It can feel a tiny bit tingly if you are not used to using retinol. The formula is gentle and scent free. I love the bottle it comes in because it is heavy duty and has some weight to it with the metal exterior. It feels solid and built to last. The pump helps you get the perfect amount every time. Retinol does take several weeks of use to find a noticeable difference, but you can see subtle changes in your skin after just a couple weeks of use. I love this retinol serum and will definitely purchase again.
Not sure it's really doing anything but maybe I'll see results at the end of the bottle. Smells nice and goes on really smoothly. It does sting a little bit? Not sure if it's supposed to do that.

I've been using this nightly underneath my regular cream, and particularly focusing on my neck. I've used retinol on my face before, but this was my first time using it on my neck. I did experience a bit of irritation after daily use, but that's to be expected with using a retinol for the first time. It absorbs really well and easily layers under other creams. I also like that there isn't a strong scent. Overall I'd recommend, but I'm curious if there will be any visible changes after using the full bottle

I really like this retinol serum! I'm now in my mid 30s and looking into retinol products to help with fine lines. To be honest I have not noticed my skin changing much yet but I am going to continue using it to see how it works. I love the beautiful light shimmer the serum has and it's the first retinol anti aging product I've tried that hasn't caused instant burning or irritation with my skin. In fact, it's very hydrating! There is no scent. There is no residue, which means it rubs in nicely and doesn't leave my skin feeling sticky. I will continue to use this! Thanks for the product, Influenster.

I received this Philosophy UMW Lift and Smooth Base & Neck Serum from Influencer to try for my honest review. This is a very attractive bottle and the appearance of the cream is a nice pinkish color. This face cream is great for sensitive skin. After many uses. I had no breakouts whatsoever. The texture of the cream was soft, creamy and subtle. The serum applied evenly on my face and neck, leaving no residue around.. This cream has very little to no sent. I have been using this serum for four weeks and I am finally starting to see a little bit of results. My face seems a little firmer with a slight glow, and I did notice my fine lines are very slowly diminishing. I will continue to use this serum during the duration time that is recommended to see even better results. I highly recommend this serum from Philosophy to try, to erase some of the aging off your face.

Wonderful product! Philosophy Ultimate Miracle Worker Serum lives up to its name truly lifting and firming. This is the first clinical strength retinol product that doesn't irritate my skin! From day one I noticed a difference in the way my skin felt in the morning, smoother, more even. It didn't leave my skin sticky and I would say I really didn't notice any scent. This is a very pleasant product to use and get the results I was hoping for.

avis.titre: Light, gentle serum that boosts healthy glow.
avis.texte: The serum has a light, creamy texture that absorbs quickly without feeling heavy. The scent is soft and clean, not too string, and the color is a pale pinkish-white. The packaging feels sturdy and looks nice, though the pump can be tricky for some. It helps smooth fine lines and gives the skin a healthier glow after a few weeks. It's gentle, works well under makeup, and feels hydrating without being greasy.

avis.titre: Committed to Completing.. but I like!
avis.texte: I've been using the Philosophy Face and neck serum as directed and I can't say that I've personally experienced noticeable results. But I will say that a little goes a long way and covers the areas well. I love that the texture is not oily but goes on really smooth and lightweight. I have had no irritation after applying. I'm committed to continue using until the product is complete.
Nice pump- generous size, especially for a serum. Blends well without oily residue. Has retinol to improve results, however does cause sun sensitivity because of this too.
This is great serum! It is very hydrating and feels good on my skin. It absorbs well and leaves skin looking glowy. I am very pleased with the results from using it.
The serums feels really nice when you put it on my skin. Did help smooth out some texture that I had on my neck. Does not irritate my skin. And doesn't have a heavy scent to it.

Absolutely love this!! It smells so good and feels so good on the face. Doesn't leave my face feeling dry or greasy. I do feel like when used consistently it is helping smooth my skin and lift it up more. A little goes a long way so this bottle will last!

avis.titre: Great night serum for people over 40
avis.texte: I love that it leaves my skin glowing. It's quick to absorb, and it hasn't given me any adverse reactions like dryness or redness. The texture is thicker than your average serum but it's very easy to spread. I'm starting to see a difference in my jawline. Overall I think this is a great serum for mature skin.

avis.titre: Very effective in reducing the appearance of wrink
avis.texte: After three weeks of using this serum, I have seen great results! I applied it only to my neck, which has the most wrinkles, to see how effective it really is. Just look at those before and after pictures! Absorbs quickly, not sticky, and fragrance free.

Being half way through my thirties, this couldn't have come at a better time! The application feels smooth and leaves the skin feeling soft yet begins to firm as the day goes. I've noticed a significant difference in my neck especially, which has been less saggy after use. Philosophy is a brand I trust and is a great value for the product!

Love this product. Not really a scent to it. You put it in and it soaks right into your skin no pilling. Fast absorption and its silky feeling. Very light product not like lotion definitely more like a serum. Will definitely purchase later.

I've been using this product for several weeks now on my neck and I like it. It's lightweight, unscented and though I haven't seen any drastic changes in my neck lines, I do feel like it's doing something. I'm hoping with more time and product that this does actually help my skin look tighter. Even though it is a higher priced product, I do want to purchase it once I am done to try it out for longer.

This serum has been pretty good, I like all the ingredients listed and I'm sure it works well. For me I did notice an increased redness and dryness after using but I think this is because it may be a little harsher than my current products. But I don't doubt that it does work well over time, I'd just recommend moisturizing afterwards and incorporating other items in your routine to reduce redness. The packaging is good and the product does absorb well so there's that!

avis.titre: Neck and face serum for mature skin with retinal a
avis.texte: I love this serum, it has a light consistency that it blends easily into skin. It's a nice formula but it's strong for beginners so I have to be used gradually to build tolerance. The size of the tube it's good enough to last more than a month. I love that this is also design for neck. Retinol and retinal smoothes the skin nicely, great benefits for mature skin

Not a bad product but not sure of its worth the price. It works well for combination skin, didnt have any breakouts. The fragrance is really subtle and its not heavy or sticky. It did leave my skin plump and soft but I dont see noticeable difference in the firmness. The pump mars it easy to use as well.

avis.titre: Saw noticeable difference in a few uses!
avis.texte: I really enjoy this serum! With just a few uses, I've noticed brightness and smoothness in my skin. I love that it is gentle and doesn't burn my skin. I do have sensitive skin, so I use it every other night and find that it works well. It is easy to apply, and a good amount of product comes in the bottle, making it worth the price. I would recommend this to others if you are looking for better skin texture and brightness without extreme drying or burning.

This has made my skin feel so soft and plump. I have sensitive skin and this works so well for me. It has no scent absorbs quickly and leaves you with such a clear beautiful glow. I did not experience any peeling. I use this a few times a week at night. I wash my face in the morning and apply sunscreen before going outside. I would not suggest using this before you go outside as it can cause sunburn.

This formula is super lightweight which I really love. A lot of retinols can be thicker or more of a lotion consistency which can tend to pill. This is more of a gel consistency and has very little scent-the little scent that there is I actually really liked and smelt fresh. Retinol is hard to see the effects of since it has to be used consistently over long periods of time so it's hard to tell how much this may have reduced fine lines, but I found it hydrating so I continue to use it nightly. It also gave my skin a nice glow as you can see in the pictures- I primarily applied to my forehead and undereyes. The packaging is also very high quality which is the first thing I noticed! It is a metal like heavyweight bottle (not cheap plastic) and the pump is really great and consistent. Even the cap has a suctioning mechanism that keeps it really secure. Overall I'll continue to use this product.

This serum is very nice. A little goes a long way. It has a light delicate scent and absorbs into my skin quickly. Did not cause any irritation when applying. I haven't been using long enough to see significant results but am looking forwards to seeing what it can do.
This is a very gentle retinol. Was not irritating or burning. I do think I need to use it longer to see reduced lines. Very soothing and I did forget sunscreen one day and did not burn.

i felt like this was really effective. my skin felt noticeably softer the next day. i did not use it long enough to see a reduction in wrinkles though. it absorbs really well and didn't irritate my skin at all. I used it at night 2-3 times a week. overall i think it's a great product

Love. I apply this at night and wake up with such hydrating skin. Feeling like I aged a bit backwards and incorporating it into my daily routine. Amazing ingredients, no irritation and perfect packaging

I've been using this Philosophy Ultimate Miracle Worker product for a little while now, and overall I'd say it's just okay. The texture is nice and it goes on smoothly without feeling heavy, which I really like. It also layers well with other products and doesn't cause irritation, which is a plus for my skin. That said, I didn't notice any dramatic improvements in fine lines or skin texture like I was hoping for. It provides decent hydration, but nothing that really stands out compared to other products at a similar price point.

avis.titre: Great secret hack for skincare maintenance
avis.texte: Very thin texture, has no scent and lightweight. Drys quickly and doesn't have a thick residue. I used it on my neck and lower jaw and it worked fine.

The comment made by my husband was that my skin looked firmer, and this was after a few weeks of use. After over a month, the lines haven't diminished which is the primary reason for me reaching for retinol. My face has slightly improved texture after using this but for the price, I don't see the payoff.

It is very gentle product to be used for who is using retinol for first time or have sensitive skin. The results are mild. If you want a really results a recommend something strong or medical grade. The packaging is really good and I didn't feel any smell.

avis.titre: Rich Serum with a nice glow and gradual results.
avis.texte: The Philosophy Serum is rich and effective. It absorbs quickly and it gives a nice glow to my face. It is a strong serum because my skin gets a little sensitive, which makes me feel that it's doing its job. The container is generous in size and the pump works well. The cap closes tightly, which I like because it keeps the product well sealed. I have used it for about a month, and it seems to be making slow changes in the texture of my skin.

I love the way this felt on my skin. I know you have to start out small with retinol but I already used a small amount prior to this so getting used to this was no issue. I didn't feel like there was any residue and it melted perfectly into the skin. Prior to this I already used the miracle worker moisturizer so they paired perfectly together. I would def recommend to anyone looking for anti aging products!

This product works super well against my wrinkles on my forehead. I also noticed that they gave me a light glow on my face, which is a bonus. The packaging is glass and a super pretty purple color. It is a little bit on the expensive side, but worth it.

This is a great skincare product. I love how after 2 weeks my skin looked noticeably smoother. I did not experience any irritation. It absorbs quickly. I do recommend following directions and building up slowly!

Well, I can't say I have seen any huge changes yet but it's frankly too soon. It's a lovely consistency and a big enough bottle to see results, I hope. My face doesn't like it but I'll use it up on my neck and upper chest.

I've been really happy with thus product overall. I used it once a day to ease into it since it contains clinical-strength retinol, and my skin handled it well with no negative reactions. I did notice an improvement in a fine line around my lip, which is a nice bonus! The only downside for me was the scent. It's faint and not very pleasant but it was not a deal breaker for me. The packaging is also beautiful and feels high quality which is a plus. Overall I did like it and will continue using it.

I've been using the Philosophy Lift & Firm Face & Neck Serum for about a month now and I really like how this feels on my skin. It's lightweight and silky so it absorbs fast without any greasy residue. It's perfect under moisturizer or makeup! It is meant to help with firmer looking skin and I've already noticed my skin feels smoother and a bit more toned especially around my neck and jawline where I usually see early signs of aging. It always has a boost of hydration making my skin feel plumper and comfortable even in dry weather. I like that it is gentler than a lot of retinal products I've tried. I introduced it gradually into my skincare routine and there hasn't been any irritation at all. The packaging is very simple but extremely sturdy and it's honestly become a step I look forward to in my routine it feels so nourishing without feeling super thick or heavy.

avis.titre: This is a great anti-aging serum!
avis.texte: I truly love this serum! And, I don't say that about too many. I feel like my skin looks better since I started using it a month ago, and I have a very advanced regular anti-aging skincare regimen, so for me to notice any improvements says a lot! The scent is light but reminds me of carrots, and does not linger. The texture is hydrating and feels good on dry skin, but would not be too heavy for oily skin either. The fact that it contains retinol, retinal, and peptides makes it a good value at 1.7 oz. I love the packaging, a glass bottle with good quality plastic pump and lid for easy, quick application. The retinol is not too strong, even for more sensitive skin to use nightly. I've seen some lightening of my sun spots, and plumping of my fine lines. Plus, my nearly 52 year old skin just looks glowy and healthier. Definitely recommend adding it to your lineup!

avis.titre: Smoother firmer skin In a serum
avis.texte: I have tried a lot of "firming" products-l that mostly just sit on top of your skin and hope for the best so I didn't have a lot of expectations going into this- but this serum surprised me in a good way. The first thing I noticed was the texture- lightweight and silky not sticky or overly watery.it absorbs quickly but still gives that slightly hydrated smooth feel after applying. I use it on both my face and neck and it layers well under moisturizer without pilling or feeling like too much- and I experienced zero irritation even with the retinol content. It also has zero added scent that I can detect with I appreciate. After a couple weeks my skin looks healthier and more even - things just feel smoother especially around my jawline and neck where I had noticed more texture recently. I appreciate that it doesn't irritate my skin and have used it without redness or sensitivity even when layer on top of my prescription retinol. It int an overnight transformation but no god skincare is- but it does do its job and there is a nice effect with consistent use. I will continue to use for texture in my regimen.

*I received this product complimentary for my honest review* The smoothing/lifting serum is a welcomed addition to my skin care routine, as it is easy to apply, has a very slight scent, and is very lightweight on the skin. Packing is nice and simple, easy to use the product. While I haven't noticed much of a change besides additional hydration, I believe over time I will see some changes. Not an overnight fix but a great addition to a daily regime.

I'm 34 & have been fairly lucky with aging, but I definitely have some fine lines that I get insecure about sometimes, especially my smile lines (glad I smile enough to have them I guess). I started using this serum as directed (starting slow & increasing the frequency after a few days) & have noticed at least some subtle results. The serum itself is really pretty and sparkly but it doesn't turn you into a disco ball. It applies smoothly and dries quickly. My biggest issue was the packaging. The pump didn't work at all & I have to open the bottle every time to be able to get and use any product, which is annoying. Not sure how widespread of an issue that is. My smile lines seem like they've faded a bit (see before and after pic) & I look forward to continuing to use this serum to see what else happens.

Product goes on very nicely. Not sticky or oily feeling. I haven't had any sensitivities to this product. It does have a scent but not over powering. I haven't been using it for long but my skin feels better after I use it. I will definitely continue using it. No big noticeable difference on my crows feet yet. I have hope it will work!
